section.name: Tomcat Native 2.0.12 Released
section.p: The Apache Tomcat Project is proud to announce the release of version 2.0.12 of Tomcat Native. The notable changes compared to 2.0.9 include:

ul.li: Add support for configuring TLS 1.3 cipher suites
Expand verification of OCSP responses and provide additional options to configure OCSP behaviour.
The windows binaries in this release have been built with OpenSSL 3.5.4 and APR 1.7.6
